note: Where the Python daemon (python/aimeat-crewai/src/aimeat_crewai/) and `aimeat connect` (aimeat/src/cli/connect/) differ on the loopback routes, the node REST routes or the MCP tool names, one entry per difference, keyed by the id `pnpm check:python-daemon` prints. Every entry is an ANSWER: why one side has something the other does not, read in both files on the date it names. Most differences are the two products being different: the connector enrols agents, holds their credentials and has its own CLI commands, while the Python package wraps REST helpers for a crew that the connector's agents reach as MCP tools instead. The list only shrinks: DAEMON_CEILING in aimeat/scripts/inventory/python-daemon.ts is the number of entries, an entry whose difference is gone fails until it is deleted, and a new entry or a higher ceiling is the developer's decision. `known` lists a difference no name comparison can see; every run prints it. Seeded 2026-10-18 (wish wish-vertailutarkistus-python-paketin-ja-liittimen-kahdennuksille).

exempt.local.connector-only:POST /local/call/{}: The shell tool dispatch behind `aimeat connect call` (src/cli/connect/tool-call.ts), used by a runner subprocess and by scripts. A crew calls the same tools over the loopback MCP endpoint (/v1/mcp on the serve daemon, mcp_client.serve_params). Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.local.connector-only:GET /local/departed: Written for a runtime on the same machine that keeps files per agent (local-departed.ts), such as a host that runs several crews from a roster. aimeat-crewai keeps no per-agent files of its own, so it has nothing to clean up from this list. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.local.connector-only:GET /local/events/n: The event long-poll for ecosystem (GEAI) sidecars and other synchronous languages (connector profile §2.3). An agent daemon reads the per-queue routes and /local/wake/next instead. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.local.connector-only:POST /local/shutdow: Stops the serve daemon; called by the E2E suites and by an operator. The Python daemon is a client of the serve daemon and never stops it. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.local.connector-only:GET /local/stats: The serve daemon's own counters, read by `aimeat connect tui` (local-stats.ts). Nothing for an agent runtime. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/agents/{}/integ: daemon.py _fetch_max_concurrent reads the owner's max_concurrent_tasks to size its worker pool. The connector's runner launches one subprocess per task and has no pool to size. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/agents/{}/tasks: daemon.py _is_cancelled re-reads a task's status before it dispatches, because a crew run is long and the owner may pause or delete the task meanwhile. The connector's runner starts a task when the push arrives and does not re-check. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/memory: daemon.py _is_cancelled's fallback for a serve daemon older than GET /local/cancelled: it scans the owner's agents.cancel.* markers. The connector itself receives cancellations as tunnel pushes. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/agents/{}/refus: daemon.py (0.31.0) asks after each crew run which calls the node refused for a missing permission, so a refused run is not reported as a success. The connector's runner reads the subprocess's exit status only. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/agents/{}/messa: daemon.py reads a message's full body from its thread, because the inbox carries a preview. The connector does not dispatch messages to a crew, so it never needs the body. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:PATCH /v1/agents/{}/mes: daemon.py marks a message delivered after the crew took it, so the next cycle does not dispatch it again. The connector does not dispatch messages to a crew. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/organisms/{}/wo: The contract engagement gate (docs/agent-workspace-contracts.md §7d): the daemon reads the agent's engagements before it acts on a workspace record. The connector delivers record events and leaves acting on them to the runtime. Read 2026-10-18.
The same gate reads the workspace manifest to find which contract a space belongs to (_space_contract). The connector leaves acting on records to the runtime. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:POST /v1/organisms/{}/w: The same gate registers an active engagement for an older workspace whose contract became known (the backfill verdict). The connector leaves acting on records to the runtime. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/datapackages/{}: datapackage.py package_versions(), a helper a crew calls in Python. The MCP side has aimeat_datapackage_publish and aimeat_datapackage_export, and no tool that lists a package's versions. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:POST /v1/datapackages: datapackage.py publish(), a helper a crew calls in Python. A connector agent publishes with the aimeat_datapackage_publish MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:POST /v1/storage: files.py upload, a helper a crew calls in Python with raw bytes. A connector agent uploads with the aimeat_storage_upload MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/messages/agent-: files.py inbox_files(), the attachments addressed to the agent as openable references. A connector agent reads its messages with the aimeat_message_inbox MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:POST /v1/agents/{}/task: files.py queues a task for another agent of the owner with file attachments. A connector agent does that with the aimeat_task_create MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:POST /v1/messages: messaging.py send(), a helper a crew calls in Python. A connector agent sends with aimeat_message_send or aimeat_dm_send. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:GET /v1/messages/agent-: messaging.py reads one conversation for a crew. A connector agent reads it with the aimeat_dm_thread MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:POST /v1/memory: offers.py publish_offers() writes agents.<name>.offers. A connector agent writes it with aimeat_memory_write; the node's own offers write path is the same record. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.python-only:POST /v1/agents/{}/tele: usage_telemetry.py reports the crew's LLM usage per run, which only an LLM-running runtime has. The connector runs no model. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:POST /v1/agents/v2/t: The ACP bridge (`aimeat connect acp`, src/cli/connect/acp/) turns an editor's Agent Client Protocol prompt into a task. The Python package is not an ACP server. Read 2026-10-18.
The ACP bridge cancels the task when the editor cancels the prompt. The Python package is not an ACP server. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:GET /v1/agents/v2/ta: The ACP bridge reads the task's result back for the editor. The Python package is not an ACP server. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:GET /v1/agents/me: The ACP bridge asks who it runs as at start. The Python daemon learns its identity from serve.json and the key file (credentials.resolve_agent_identity). Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:* /v1/agents/v2/toke: The connector mints the agent's access token from its key (agent-key.ts). The Python daemon holds no credential: the serve daemon attaches it to every proxied call. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:POST /v1/agents/devi: Device authorization (RFC 8628) in `aimeat connect add`. The Python package leaves enrolment to the connector by design. Read 2026-10-18.
The polling half of device authorization in `aimeat connect add`. The Python package leaves enrolment to the connector by design. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:GET /v1/agents/me/ha: `aimeat connect docs <module>` and the connector MCP's handbook resources. The Python liaison reads the handbook with the aimeat_handbook_get MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:POST /v1/agents/v2/e: Enrolment of a basic agent's key in `aimeat connect` (enrolment.ts). The Python package leaves enrolment to the connector by design. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:GET /v1/agents/{}/me: `aimeat connect inbox` and the connector MCP's poller list pending messages. The Python daemon reads the unified GET /v1/agents/{}/inbox, which carries pending messages and waiting tasks in one answer. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:GET /v1/agents/me/ha: The connector MCP's handbook resource list (resources.ts). The Python liaison reads the handbook with the aimeat_handbook_get MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:POST /v1/agents/{}/m: `aimeat connect send`, a CLI command. The Python package sends with POST /v1/messages or the aimeat_message_send MCP tool. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:GET /v1/wallet: `aimeat connect status` prints the owner's balance. A crew has no status command. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.rest.connector-only:POST /v1/agents/{}/t: The connector's runner reports a subprocess's progress over REST (task-runner.ts). A crew reports through the aimeat_task_event MCP tool, which is in the daemon's default tool list. Read 2026-10-18.
The connector's runner completes a task with the subprocess's output. A crew completes it through the aimeat_task_complete MCP tool, which is in the daemon's default tool list. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.tool.not-on-connector:aimeat_offers_chec: A CrewAI tool the package itself defines (offers_tool.py, @tool), which validates an offers document offline in Python. It is the package's own tool, never loaded from the connector. Read 2026-10-18.
exempt.tool.not-on-connector:aimeat_offers_publ: A CrewAI tool the package itself defines (offers_tool.py, @tool), which publishes the offers document with publish_offers(). It is the package's own tool, never loaded from the connector. Read 2026-10-18.

known.incident-aimeat-crewai-the-contract-enga: daemon.py _space_contract keys the workspace manifest by objectType.name, while the record event's `space` carries the space's namespace (src/services/connect-tunnel-push.ts, `space: namespace`). Both are strings in a field called space, so a name comparison cannot tell them apart. Open incident; the fix belongs in aimeat-crewai and needs a release.
